output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds arbitrary amount of tokens to target without checking if the total supply exceeds the maximum possible supply, allowing the owner to arbitrarily increase the balance of any other user.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It fails to check if the balance of the target is sufficient, allowing users to transfer more tokens than the owner has.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It fails to check if the balance of the contract is sufficient, allowing users to sell more tokens than the contract has.
